paite: Lungtang kisakkholna mihing a ahi; himahleh lei dawnna TOUPA a kipan ahi.
english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

paite: Mihing lampi tengteng ama mit ah asiang a; himahleh TOUPA'N khate abuk zel hi.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah na nasepte kemsak inla, huan na ngaihtuahnate hihkip in a-om ding hi.
english: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

paite: TOUPA'N thil chiteng aziak nei in abawlta; ahi, gilou nangawn gilou ni a ding in.
english: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

paite: Michih lungtang kisathei TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; thei in, gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak in thulimlouhna suksiang ahi; huan TOUPA kihtakna in mite hoih lou a kipan apaimang uhi.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

paite: Mihing lampite'n TOUPA asuk lungkim chiang in, amelmate nangawn amah toh kilem in abawl hi.
english: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

paite: Diktatna toh tawmchik ahoihzaw, diklouhna toh summuhna thupi sang in.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

paite: Mihing lungtang in alampi angaihtuah a; himahleh TOUPA'N akalsuante abawlsak hi.
english: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

paite: Kumpipa muk ah Pathian thu a-om; akam in vaihawmnate ah atalek kei ding hi.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

paite: Bukna dik leh tehna dik TOUPA a ahi uh; ip gikna tengteng anasep ahi.
english: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

paite: Kumpipate a ding in gilou hih kihhuai ahi; laltutphah lah diktatna a hihkip ahi ngal a.
english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

paite: Muk diktatte kumpipate kipahna ahi; huan thudik gente a-it uhi.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

paite: Kumpipa thangpaihna sihna sawltakte bang ahi; himahleh mipil in ahih lungdam ding hi.
english: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

paite: Kumpipa melvakna ah hinna a-om; huan adeihsakna vuah nanung meipi bang ahi.
english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

paite: Pilna muh dangka-eng sang in nak hoih zawk hi na e; ahi, theihsiamna muh dangka sang a tel zawk ding ahi.
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

paite: Mitang lamlian hoih lou a kipan a paimang ahi; kuapeuh alampi kem in akha ahawi hi.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

paite: Siatna ma ah kisaktheihna apai a, huan lungsim ki-uangsak pukna ma ah.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

paite: Gentheite toh lungsim niamkhiak a om ahoihzaw, kisathei toh gallak hawm sang in.
english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

paite: Kuapeuh thu limsak in hoih amu ding; huan kuapeuh TOUPA muang, ama'n nuam asa hi.
english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

paite: Lungtang pil pilvang akichi ding; huan muk khumna in sinsiamna apungsak hi.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

paite: Theihsiamna neimi a ding in hinna luikhuk ahi; himahleh mihaite bawlhoihna ahaina uh ahi.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

paite: Mipil lungtang in akam ahilh a, huan amuk ah sinsiamna abehlap hi.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

paite: Thu kipahhuai khuaizu bang ahi, kha a dia khum, guhte a dia damna.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

paite: Mihing a dia dik hileh kilawm lampi a-om, himahleh huai tawpna sihna lampite ahi.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

paite: Nasem gimmi ankam limna in amah a ding in asemgim a; agilkialna in huai a kipan alunggulh ngal a.
english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

paite: Mithulim lou in siatna angaihtuah; huan amuk ah meisa bang a-om hi.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

paite: Miki-uangsak in kinakna athehzak a; huan huauhatmi in lawm bulte akhenzak hi.
english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

paite: Hiamgammi in a-invengte akhem a, ahoih lou lam lampi ah api.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

paite: Kuapeuh amitsik-at in thil hoih lou agel ahi; kuapeuh amuk chih in hoih lou ahon tun nak hi.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

paite: Samkang zaw thupina lallukhu ahi, diktatna lampi ah muh ahi.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

paite: Kuapeuh heh hak mihat sang in ahoihzaw; huan kuapeuh alungsim thuzoh khopi lak sang in.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

paite: Angsung ah ai akisan a; himahleh huai ahihpaisuakna zaw TOUPA a kipan ahi.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.
